name: Wonder Valley (Alberta)
locality: Greenview Industrial Gateway, ~42 km south of Grande Prairie
status_note: Off-grid AI data centre park with its own gas power proposed Dec 2024 (initially reported as a $70B park); Alberta permitting under way (Feb 2026), land sale contract signed Mar 2026; phased development now expected 2028–2029.

announced.note: Municipal District of Greenview media release, 9 Dec 2024; public kickoff 10 Dec 2024.

sources.title: Kevin O'Leary wants to build natural gas-powered AI data centre in Alberta

Wonder Valley data centre, Alberta (The Big Read)

review_notes: Capacity for the Alberta site not confirmed (7.5 GW in the 2026 release is the Utah campus; reported gas plant up to 8.5 GW). Drawn as a dot until a sourced data centre figure exists. Approximate location.
